method: Passive Cooking Reset & Work Zone Isolation
key_principles: Begin with an empty sink to prevent countertop congestion
Use a single scrap bowl during food prep to protect cutting board space
Utilize passive cooking intervals (simmering, baking) for surface resets
Establish a safe dish landing zone beside the sink
Group ingredients by perishable urgency rather than aesthetic categories
Temporarily remove one door shelf to accommodate tall roasting platters
Maintain a 1-inch perimeter around vents to ensure uninterrupted cold airflow

method: Flash-Freeze Single Layer & Measured Mash Storage
quality_window_months: 4-6 months for peeled mash or slices
